requirements.evidence: Contract is essentially complete: routes/web.php:21-52 registers login/register (Livewire, guest), logout (POST), home (auth+verified), password.request/email/reset/update with throttle:6,1, and verification.notice/verify/send with signed+throttle. app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:20-67 does strict e-mail + auth.failed + per lowercased e-mail/IP lockout + session regeneration + redirectIntended(route('home')); app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:37-81 does unique strict e-mail, Password::defaults(), confirmed rule, str()->transliterate('register|'.$ip) limiter, Registered event, Auth::login and session regeneration; app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:33-57 validates token/e-mail/default password and rotates remember_token before firing PasswordReset; app/Models/User.php:16 implements MustVerifyEmail; .env.example:6-7,14 and phpunit.xml:22-23 pin the locale; both ui.php files carry the same keys. Gaps: requirement 9's route()-only rule explicitly includes existing views, but no existing view appears in the diff (only a scan test at tests/Feature/Auth/AuthConfigurationTest.php:50-59), so that part is asserted rather than shown; Register.php:65-68 charges the IP limiter before validation, so typos consume the 5 attempts.

conventions.evidence: Follows the project patterns: Livewire validation uses #[Validate] + $this->validate() (app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:20-24,31-42; app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:29-44), all redirects use named routes (Login.php:67, Register.php:81, app/Http/Controllers/LogoutController.php:21), the layout is an anonymous Blade component (resources/views/components/layouts/auth.blade.php:1), $fillable stays deliberate on User (app/Models/User.php:14), and docs/CHANGELOG were updated (docs/business-rules.md:69-79, CHANGELOG.md:12-14). Deviation: app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:33-37 inline-validates three fields, where conventions ask for a Form Request once rules exceed one or two fields; repeated field markup is also not extracted into a Blade component.

security.evidence: No weakness found. Every Livewire action re-checks auth server-side before doing anything (Login.php:35-38, Register.php:51-54), all client-writable input is validated (Login.php:20-24, Register.php:29-44), sensitive actions are rate-limited with RateLimiter (Login.php:44-56, Register.php:57-66), sessions are regenerated on login/register (Login.php:64-65, Register.php:78-79) and invalidated with token rotation on logout (LogoutController.php:17-20). Verification is authorized server-side against the logged-in user's id+hash via the base framework request (app/Http/Requests/Auth/EmailVerificationRequest.php:11-14) on a signed, throttled route (routes/web.php:42-43), matching the tamper tests. Output is escaped with {{ }} (resources/views/home.blade.php:3, resources/views/livewire/auth/login.blade.php:23), and mass assignment is bounded by #[Fillable(['name','email','password'])].

tests.evidence: Strong Pest coverage across tests/Feature/Auth: login happy path, case-insensitive e-mail, remember token, auth.failed, malformed e-mail, 5-attempt lockout and per-account scoping, audit logging without the e-mail, and an authenticated-user tamper test (tests/Feature/Auth/LoginTest.php); registration happy path, lowercase storage, password policy, confirmed, unique, IP throttle and authenticated tamper test (tests/Feature/Auth/RegisterTest.php); logout, CSRF regeneration, POST-only; forgot/reset including token reuse for another e-mail and remember_token rotation; verification signed/unsigned/wrong-hash/tampered-id/guest/resend/already-verified (tests/Feature/Auth/EmailVerificationTest.php). Missing: no test for the throttle:6,1 on the signed verification link (only resend is throttled-tested at EmailVerificationTest.php:110-119), and no feature test that GET /register is guest-only (RegisterTest.php:105-127 only tests the component guard).

simplicity.evidence: Lean overall: small focused components, framework broker/notification reuse, and no service or repository layer. Some removable code: app/Http/Requests/Auth/EmailVerificationRequest.php:11-14 is an empty subclass that could be replaced by the framework request type-hint, the guard/limiter blocks in Login.php:35-66 and Register.php:51-79 are near-duplicates, and the CDN fallback branch in resources/views/components/layouts/auth.blade.php:10-15 is extra machinery.

readability.evidence: Clear class/method names and short methods (Login::submit 31-67, Register::submit 47-82, NewPasswordController::store 31-58), useful docblocks, consistent Laravel/Bulma style with sibling code, no dead code, debug output or commented-out blocks; error/aria wiring is easy to follow (resources/views/livewire/auth/login.blade.php:9-27).

scope.evidence: Nearly everything serves the auth/localization task and the required docs sync. Small extras beyond the task: a conditional Bulma CDN stylesheet fallback in resources/views/components/layouts/auth.blade.php:10-15 (the task's asset story is the existing SCSS build), and audit-channel logging of failed/locked logins in app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:47,56, which the task did not ask for though it matches the project's logging conventions.

issues.explanation: No existing view (welcome/bulma-test) is touched even though requirement 9 says the route()-only rule applies to every view including the existing ones; the new scan test would fail if any of them still contain href="/...", so compliance is asserted rather than demonstrated.

The signed verification link is throttled with throttle:6,1 but no test exercises that limit (only verification.send gets a 429 test at tests/Feature/Auth/EmailVerificationTest.php:110-119), leaving requirement 7's 'throttled link' unverified.

Only the Livewire submit guard is tested for authenticated visitors; there is no feature test that GET /register itself is guest-only, unlike the equivalent login test in tests/Feature/Auth/LoginTest.php:80-84.

RateLimiter::hit() runs before $this->validate(), so five mistyped or otherwise invalid submissions from one IP use up the 5-attempt budget and lock the user out of the registration form for 60 seconds.
Three fields (token, e-mail, password) are validated inline, while conventions.md calls for a Form Request once rules grow beyond one or two fields.
The subclass is empty and adds nothing over Illuminate\Foundation\Auth\EmailVerificationRequest, which the controller could type-hint directly.

The conditional Bulma CDN stylesheet is an external dependency and build-bypass the task never asked for, and it only checks that the manifest exists, not that the configured Vite entry points are present.

review.summary: The change implements the whole session-auth surface (Livewire login/register, logout, forgot/reset password, e-mail verification, pt-BR-first UI, locale pins and docs) with server-side validation, rate limiting, session regeneration and good test coverage. It is close to mergeable; the remaining gaps are small: existing views are not shown to comply with the route()-only rule, the verification-link throttle and guest-only /register page are untested, the register limiter counts invalid submissions, and there are a few convention/simplicity nits.
